issues.explanation: Chapter 89 calls the final Yang锋 capture of 孟获 the fourth capture, although it has already narrated an earlier fourth capture and the source makes the Yang锋 episode the fifth. Chapter 90 then follows the source's later sequence and calls the eventual outcome 七擒七纵, so the cross-chapter capture count is inconsistent.
issues.suggested_fix: At the end of Chapter 89, change the count to the fifth capture (and adjust any wording implying it is the fourth); then Chapter 90's later sixth and seventh captures and 七擒七纵 will track coherently.
